title: People’s Mañanera August 18
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Public Health System Exceeds 100 Million Consultations  
** Through the IMSS, ISSSTE, and IMSS-Bienestar public healthcare systems, 101
million general consultations were registered. "Instead of going to the
private sector, people are turning to the public healthcare system," President
Claudia Sheinbaum explained.

**IMSS-Bienestar: Free Care Leads to More Treatment  
** In the 24 states that have joined the IMSS-Bienestar program, general
consultations have increased by 50% since 2023, and specialty consultations by
90%. "These are very clear indicators that people's access to healthcare is
improving," Sheinbaum noted.

**Healthcare Closer to Families  
** Sheinbaum will present a progress report on the "House-to-House Healthcare"
program and "Well-being Pharmacies", which are projected to be established in
6,000 locations. In addition, nearly 3 million beneficiaries already have
their health care ID cards, which can be used in any of the public health care
systems and contain their medical histories.

**Sovereignty and Validation Lie with the People  
** After it was revealed that PRI senator Alito paid US$120,000 to a U.S.
consulting firm, the President challenged the right-wing, arguing that
"sovereignty does not lie in the validation of a foreign government; it lies
in the validation of the people."

**Fabricated Trends Do Not Represent the People  
** The President warned that bots, trolls, and paid social media networks
amplify fake news and fabricate trends. In response, she noted that a door-to-
door survey showed 80% support for policies to defend audience rights.
